title: About Unbill
name: unbill
summary: Private, local-first bill splitting for the people you share life with.

sections.title: Less bookkeeping. More living.
paragraphs: A home, a trip, a meal together. Keep track of who paid, split costs fairly, and see how to settle up — without making shared expenses a second job.

Your ledger stays under your control. Work offline on your devices and sync directly with people you trust. There are no Unbill accounts or analytics. The web frontend connects to a server you choose to trust.

sections.title: A small app. A long-term experiment.
paragraphs: Unbill is also an experiment in software architecture. We keep refining it with established standards, clear boundaries, and designs we can reason about and verify.
The ambition is simple: let careful engineering make everyday software more dependable, more understandable, and easier to use.

sections.title: Built together.
paragraphs: Thank you to everyone who contributes code, design, documentation, translations, testing, and thoughtful bug reports. Every improvement, large or small, helps shape Unbill.

sections.title: Like where this is going?
paragraphs: A star on GitHub helps other people discover Unbill. Come follow the project, share an idea, or help build what comes next.
